description.narrative:
Huvudmål
Förbättra Armeniens motståndskraft mot interna och externa utmaningar samtidigt som man främjar medborgarnas individuella och kollektiva rättigheter.
Förväntade resultat
- Ökad medvetenhet och respekt för mänskliga rättigheter, inklusive rättigheterna för fördrivna människor och minoriteter.
- Ökad förståelse för jämställdhetsfrågor och bättre praxis för kvinnors engagemang och deltagande.
- Mer transparent, mer ansvarsfull och effektivare offentlig förvaltning, lägre nivåer av korruption.
- Ökat medborgerligt engagemang och delaktighet i demokratiska processer som ett resultat av informerat beslutsfattande.
- Ökad medvetenhet om miljöutmaningar och bättre praxis på besluts- och individnivå.
– Ökad förståelse för energifrågor som bidrar till landets energidiversifiering och självständighet.
- Ökad kapacitet och förtroende för CivilNet som en pålitlig och opartisk informations- och analyskälla som bevakar det politiska etablissemanget och ger konstruktiv journalistik.

Main Goal
Enhance Armenia's resilience to internal and external challenges while promoting individual and collective rights of its citizens.
Expected Outcomes
- Increased awareness and respect of human rights, including the rights of displaced people and minorities.
- Increased understanding of gender equality issues and better practices of women’s involvement and participation.
- More transparent, more accountable and more efficient public administration, lower levels of corruption.
- Increased civic engagement and participation in democratic processes as a result of informed decision-making.
- Increased awareness of environmental challenges and better practices on decision making and individual levels.
- Increased understanding of energy issues that contributes to the country’s energy diversification and independence.
- Increased capacity and trust in CivilNet as a reliable and impartial source of information and analysis that watchdogs the political establishment and comes up with constructive journalism.

Main Goal - Enhance Armenia's resilience to internal and external challenges while promoting individual and collective rights of its citizens.
Objectives
- To strengthen the media project CivilNet within the Civilitas Foundation in its institutional capacity-building by providing in-house and outside training for journalists and the editorial team, as well as promoting the use of innovative tools and technologies, including AI, in storytelling, information production, and countering disinformation, with the aim to improve the access of and quality of journalism for the public, as this is deemed important for improved democratic development in Armenia.
- To promote democracy, human rights, and gender equality through producing high-quality media products aimed at solutions.
- To produce and publish journalism that may lead to increase transparency and accountability, including in the field of environmental management, via monitoring the public procurement processes and management at both the community and national levels, and producing journalistic investigations and analyses.
- To produce and publish journalism that may to support security, including information security, and to contribute to Armenia's resilience and energy diversification by holding peace talks, producing in-depth media materials, and organizing public forums, including those for promoting society's environmental literacy and responsibility.
